finding: v1 could write --receipt inside the owning checkout after its invariance check and therefore potentially return PASS while dirtying the checkout it claimed not to mutate. A user-supplied --capsule-dir inside the owning checkout could also mutate it before failing. This violates the bootstrap no-owning-worktree-mutation contract.

fixes: reject receipt path inside owning checkout before any remote transport
reject capsule path inside owning checkout before any write
recheck owning HEAD/tree/status immediately before PASS
record status digests and capsule outside-owning-checkout assertion
